response: Read the guidance and identify the storage path and invocation settings required for each case.

cases.input: Run Rust patch verification from a separate upstream worktree; existing Cargo caches are in the user's home cache directory.
cases.acceptance: Resolve the project's .cat/work/temp/build-caches to an absolute path and explicitly set CARGO_TARGET_DIR, CARGO_HOME, and any task-managed RUSTUP_HOME beneath it. Do not reuse the home caches; confirm effective paths before invocation.

cases.input: Run a uv-backed formatting command from an upstream checkout and require an isolated verification cache.
cases.acceptance: Explicitly set UV_CACHE_DIR beneath the project's .cat/work/temp/build-caches using an absolute path and a separate verification subdirectory. Configure any other participating tool caches there and confirm effective paths.

cases.input: Inspect installed application configuration or review hosted CI cache settings without running a local build.
cases.acceptance: Do not relocate user configuration or installed application data or change hosted CI cache storage under this rule.
